english_draft:
Samsung Electronics released its Q2 2026 results on July 30, 2026.
We have no preview written before the release.
This analysis uses only the official news release.

The company reported revenue of KRW 171.5 trillion.
The company reported operating profit of KRW 89.5 trillion.
Both figures were all-time quarterly highs.
Revenue rose 28% quarter-on-quarter.
Earnings per share were KRW 10,849.
EPS increased 52%.

The DS Division reported revenue of KRW 127.5 trillion.
DS operating profit was KRW 89.2 trillion.
Memory achieved record quarterly revenue and operating profit.
Server demand drove the record.
The company scaled HBM4 sales.
The company shipped the first HBM4E samples in the industry.

System LSI held quarterly revenue steady.
High-volume mobile SoCs and image sensors drove sales.
First-half revenue reached a record high.
Foundry earnings improved significantly before incentive-related provisions.
HBM base-die demand and US customers drove the improvement.

SDC reported revenue of KRW 7.5 trillion.
SDC operating profit was KRW 0.7 trillion.
MX and Networks reported revenue of KRW 33.2 trillion.
MX and Networks reported an operating loss of KRW 0.7 trillion.
VD and DA reported revenue of KRW 14.5 trillion.
VD and DA reported a slight operating loss.
Harman improved earnings.

For H2 2026, Memory expects robust server demand.
The market will remain undersupplied.
Foundry plans to ramp second-generation 2nm products.
Foundry targets double-digit revenue growth.
SDC plans timely mass production of the 8.6G IT OLED line.
MX plans flagship-led expansion with Galaxy Z8 and S26 series.
MX will launch Intelligent Eyewear.
VD plans to lead the AI TV market.
DA plans to expand AI-based product sales.

No comparable preview exists.
This analysis does not compare actual results with a prior projection.
reader_questions: EPS 增加 52%，来源没有说明是与上年同期还是上季度比较，正文是否写错了基准？
DX 整体销售环比下降 9%，但文中说 MX、VD/DA 收入增长，读者会不会把同比和环比混淆？
Foundry 盈利显著改善的表述是“计提激励相关拨备前”，如果不保留限定词，是否会让读者误以为 Foundry 已经实际盈利？
fact_checks: 币种/单位：KRW 万亿韩元，采用公司新闻稿合并口径。
关键数字：营收 171.5 万亿、营业利润 89.5 万亿、EPS 10,849 韩元均与来源一致。
分部数字：DS 127.5/89.2、SDC 7.5/0.7、MX/网络 33.2/-0.7、VD/DA 14.5/小幅亏损均与来源一致。
EPS 增幅未指明同比或环比，正文不限定基准，避免误导。
DS、SDC、MX、VD/DA 等分部收入相加不等于合并收入，正文未做加总推断。
DX 整体环比下降 9% 与 MX/VD/DA 的同比口径不同，正文已注明并非同一基准。
Foundry 盈利改善限定为“计提激励相关拨备前”，正文保留该限定。
H2 展望均为公司表述，正文作为公司计划/指引处理，不视为事实或共识。
